events.title: The Unhidden LIVE – Next Fest demo playthrough with the developer
events.summary: The Unhidden is in Steam Next Fest! Join the developer live while playing the free demo of our third-person psychological survival horror.Ask anything in the chat: how it's made, what's coming in the full game, or what scared you the most. Feedback on the demo is very welcome.If you enjoy it, adding The Unhidden to your wishlist helps our small indie team a lot.

events.title: The Unhidden Demo 0.9.4: Discord, outlines and sharper spiders
events.summary: Give us your feedback The end-of-demo screen now has a "Give us your feedback" row with the Discord icon: it opens The Unhidden's Discord server. The closing text also makes it clear that the cabin was only the start of a long night. The demo is the complete first chapter, and the full game continues far beyond the cabin. In the game Items you can pick up now have an outline when you focus on them, so they no longer get lost in the grain of the image. Readable notes: notes are read from the inve

events.title: The Unhidden Demo 0.9.2: Now on Mac
events.summary: Now on Mac The demo now runs natively on Mac, on both Apple Silicon and Intel (macOS 12 Monterey or later). Steam Cloud saves work on Mac too. Picking things up The pickup prompt no longer disappears when you walk right up to an item. Before, you sometimes had to step back and approach it again. If another prompt covers it, such as a door's, it now comes back on its own. Items at hand height are picked up standing: the protagonist reaches out, takes them and stows them.
